_: Pivot arm: a 22 mm block on the grip plane, dropped into the carriage key plate’s open notch and bottomed on the back plate, carrying the link pivot pin at x 34 with a link seated on each of its faces. Bored Ø10.2 at x 24 for its pillar: the arm slides on it, and that is what holds the plunger square and stops it turning. Two per gripper (side = 1 right, -1 left); a set screw holds it in the carriage (not modelled). Local origin at the carriage centre. One extrude along +Z, then the pillar bore as a cut along Y.
